name: PyramidKV
summary: Spend more cache on early layers than late ones. Attention widens near the input and narrows with depth, so a uniform per-layer budget overfeeds the layers that need it least.

source.title: PyramidKV: Dynamic KV Cache Compression based on Pyramidal Information Funneling

params.name: budget
params.description: Average token positions kept per layer. The pyramid redistributes this across layers.

params.name: layer
params.description: Which layer this instance serves, counting from the input.

params.name: numLayers
params.description: Layers the budget is shared across. One means no redistribution.

params.name: pyramidRatio
params.description: How many times more cache the first layer gets than the last.

params.name: recentWindow
params.description: The most recent positions, never evicted whatever their score.

params.name: obsWindow
params.description: How many recent decode steps the score is summed over.

params.name: poolKernel
params.description: Width of the max-pool across neighbouring kept positions. Must be odd.

notes: On a single-layer trace the pyramid allocation is inert and this behaves exactly as SnapKV. See README.
